**EXP-999 — a deliberately malformed finding.**

This file has no `#` or `##` heading at all, so it fails the `has-heading` check that gives
the `finding` type its teeth (plan-048 Issue 2.9).

It also carries none of the four sections `investigator.md` mandates (`Approach Tested`,
`Result`, `Implications for Plan`, `Recommendations`) and no `**measured:**` / `**inferred:**`
epistemic marker — both now report-only, because those files are written DURING execution,
after the gate that would judge them.
